source: HAI technical details (hai_dataset_technical_details.pdf, icsdataset/hai, CC BY-SA 4.0): HAI 20.07 table p.39-41, HAI 21.03 table p.36-38, HAI 22.04 table p.33-35
transcribed: 2026-10-07, before any replication run; attack order = chronological order of contiguous attack==1 segments in the test files
spoofed_meaning: PV target points whose scenario description is 'attempt to maintain/repeat previous sensor value' (stale-value spoofing). Only points that are replication sources are listed.
process_labels: 20.07 and 21.03: from the attack_P1/P2/P3 columns. 22.04 (no per-process columns): from the target controllers in the manual.

hai-21.03.notes: Combination attacks paired as (line above ID, line below ID); every pairing agrees with the attack_P1/P2/P3 columns. A401 is AP03 + AP12 (LIT01 spoofed).

hai-22.04.notes: Attacks 41-49 (A407-A415) excluded: the manual's page-35 layout does not identify which primitive lines belong to which ID. A302-A307 targets column is shifted by one row in the PDF; resolved from the scenario names. A307 spoofs P1_TIT01, which is not a source.
